stereotypeDefinition.comment: One opt-in rule the drift engine runs, optionally narrowed to some files.
stereotypeDefinition.name: Drift Check Opt-in Rule

property.hint: The rule's id, as its findings carry it.
property.name: Rule

property.hint: Optional. The files the rule reports on, one glob per line, relative to the output folder. It narrows the rule within scope and never widens it.
property.name: Glob

property.hint: What the row's files are, such as the layer and what it holds. The list shows it, so rows of the same rule can be told apart.
property.name: Description
property.placeholder: e.g. Domain layer: entities, enums and repositories
